title: Electric 30 Concrete Pump Catalogue Row
seoTitle: Electric 30 Concrete Pump | Pinjin 30 kW 12–15 m³/h Xingtai
description: Electric 30 is a Xingtai electric trailer pump: 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, fine stone 60 m / 180 m, aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m, aggregate ≤ 3 cm, 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm, 1200 kg. No Kawasaki cell on this page. It is not Low Pressure 40.

answerBlock.what: Electric 30 Concrete Pump is an electric trailer concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, fine stone 60 m / 180 m, aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m, aggregate ≤ 3 cm, 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm, 1200 kg. A hydraulic-pump brand is not printed. It is not Low Pressure 40 and not a boom pump.
answerBlock.who: Grid sites matched to 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and fine stone 60 m / 180 m, with stone at or under 3 cm, on a 1200 kg trailer.
factors: Fine stone 60 / 180 m versus aggregate-13 20 / 60 m on the same page
30 kW / 12–15 m³/h versus Low Pressure 40 at 37 kW / 12–15 m³/h / fine stone 80 / 240 m / Kawasaki 112
No Kawasaki cell on Electric 30
SmartBuy trailer 30–90 m³/h does not replace 12–15 m³/h

faqs.question: Does Electric 30 print a Kawasaki hydraulic pump?
faqs.answer: No. Electric 30 prints 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, fine stone 60 m / 180 m, aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m and aggregate ≤ 3 cm. Low Pressure 40 prints Kawasaki 112 on its own page.

faqs.question: Can I use Electric 30’s 60 m / 180 m fine-stone cell with 3 cm stone?
faqs.answer: The same page prints aggregate-13 pumping at 20 m / 60 m and max aggregate ≤ 3 cm. Fine stone 60 m / 180 m is the fine-stone row. Match stone size to the printed pair.
